service_name.description: The name of the service/package being configured.

escape_key.description: The escape key sequence to enter file transfer mode. Format ^X where X is a character (e.g., ^@, ^A, ^[). Default is Ctrl-Space (^@).

remote_shell_cmd.description: Alternative command to run as remote shell (e.g., 'ssh -e none', 'telnet -8 -E'). If empty, defaults are used.

force_mode.description: If true, sets the FORCE flag to skip user questions (equivalent to -f/--force).

zssh_host.description: The remote hostname or IP address to connect to via SSH.

zssh_user.description: The username for the remote SSH connection.
